x: Whilst mentioning Shot Putters we are pleased to welcome Derek McCorquindale who recorded a best of 50'3" and was in the English team at Cardiff.

Percy Porter gave us a good start with 4th place in the hammer (155'9"), Derek McCorquindale, in his first outing for Belgrave, showed his class and won the shot with 49'0¼" and our Captain Dave Ansell took second place in the long jump with 21'4½" and, deputising for Norman Caves, 5th in the triple…

Dereck McCorquindale won the shot with a putt of 46ft 4½ins, whilest Dave Ansell secured third place in the long-jump with 21'4¾". In a very close 100 yds finish Sylvan Deane was 4th in 10.5 secs; and to complete the picture Eric Smith was sixth in the 2 mile walk.

Derek McCorquindale has no doubt been our best class performer. His new Club Championship best with the Shot of 49'9" and later the same day a 51'4" to win the Bucks Championships were two of his best efforts; he was also selected for A.A.A. teams.
Shot (7.257Kg) · Derek McCorquindale · Halton · 6/6/59 · Bucks Champs (1st) · 15.78
